verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents its own aftermarket, which can be used via its API to place backorders, discover auction listings and place bids. Its llms.txt also lists aftermarket services. That gives a first-party path for taken names, but no evidence shows premium pricing in search results. missing for 10: premium pricing displayed in domain search, a broker service for taken names, in-depth marketplace documentation beyond API mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, premium and aftermarket domains are first-class — premium pricing shown in search, and a marketplace or broker path for taken names

citations.quote: Use our API to engage with our aftermarket - place backorder requests, discover new auction listings, place bids, and more.
Dynadot is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar offering domain registration, aftermarket services
